cases.source: const d=new Date(0);if(!d.toString().startsWith("Thu Jan 01 1970 08:00:00 GMT+0800")||d.toDateString()!=="Thu Jan 01 1970"||!d.toTimeString().startsWith("08:00:00 GMT+0800"))throw 1;if(Date.parse(d.toString())!==0||new Date(d.toString()).getTime()!==0)throw 2;
